title: A/R Summary: no rows after a customer pick, and the Location chip stays
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, location A and your other location.
  • Have a customer, customer A, with open invoices only at your other location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with only location A ticked in the Location filter.
custom_steps:
1. In the Customer filter, tick customer A.
  2. Click "Clear all filters".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report is empty: customer A has nothing open at location A.
  • The empty state reads "No record matches these filters" and "Try changing filters to widen your results." with a "Clear all filters" button.
  • The Location chip stays visible so the selection can be cleared.

Step 2:

  • The Customer and Location filters return to their defaults ("Customer: All customers", "Location: All locations").
  • The as-of date stays.
  • Rows show again.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location), story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout)

  • S5-E1: “If a location is chosen and the user then picks a customer or vendor with nothing open there, the report is empty and the Location chip stays visible so the selection can be cleared.”
  • S8-R5: “While a report loads it shows the native table progress bar. When the filters leave no rows, it shows the native empty state: "No record matches these filters" and "Try changing filters to widen your results.", with a "Clear all filters" button when a customer or vendor, Past due or Location is chosen; that button keeps the as-of date and returns the customer or vendor, Past due and Location to their defaults (every location ticked).”
